test_title: PYST 5: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 13th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The medieval __**oriel**__ window extended outward from the hall.

options.text: Guests admired the view from the oriel.
The guards stood beside the oriel during patrol.
The engineer adjusted the signal on the auriel.
The ornate oriel was restored by craftsmen.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option (3)'** i.e. *'The engineer adjusted the signal on the auriel.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Oriel**: Refers to a type of bay window that projects from the wall of a building, especially seen in medieval architecture. (एक प्रकार की झरोखा खिड़की - ओरियल)
